findings.evidence: "Open the alerts panel from the console sidebar and select the rule you want to adjust."
findings.violation: The instruction combines two actions without clarifying their order or whether they occur simultaneously.
findings.fix: Revise to "From the console sidebar, open the alerts panel. Then select the rule you want to adjust."

findings.evidence: "A threshold is the numeric boundary that triggers an alert once a metric crosses it."
findings.violation: This definition appears without a section heading and interrupts the procedural flow between opening settings and setting a threshold.
findings.fix: Add a section heading like "About thresholds" before this definition, or move it to an "Overview" section at the top of the document.

findings.evidence: "This is because the console applies the new threshold to every future evaluation of this rule."
findings.violation: The explanation of why to confirm the unit is confusing and uses unclear pronoun reference ("this is because").
findings.fix: Revise to clarify the cause-effect relationship: "The unit matters because the console applies the threshold to future evaluations of this rule, so mismatched units will cause incorrect alerts."

findings.violation: The pronoun "there" is ambiguous and could refer to the rule list, the settings panel, or other locations.
findings.fix: Replace with a specific location: "confirm the updated threshold value appears in the rule list."
